propositions: The completion-verification gate chronically fails without verdicts due to runaway duplicate tool-call loops, request-budget exhaustion, and a flat 100,000-char recovery context bound that cannot accommodate live tickets like c9f7 (121,147 chars).
Recovery currently fans out one isolated LLM run per criterion, creating worst-case 440 requests and ~2.67M re-sent context chars for 22 criteria with 20-request budget.
The gate lacks a deterministic no-LLM fallback; runs with banked progress can die verdict-less when primary execution exhausts resources.
Duplicate read-only tool calls within single agentic runs are re-executed rather than memoized, causing measurable waste and runaway loops.
Context pre-loading of ranked file_impact contents is not implemented, leaving 67-82% of distinct file reads as avoidable agentic round-trips.
